# Life Manager deck source

## 1 — Life Manager

A proactive general agent for body, mind, money, and real-world follow-through.

## 2 — Problem

People know what would improve their lives, but action stops between disconnected calendars, forms, health routines, and financial accounts.

## 3 — Product

Life Manager coordinates specialist organs, chooses work and priorities, executes ongoing workflows, and verifies external outcomes with receipts. The hosted target starts with email signup and sends daily email reports; Telegram is optional. Users are not required to define goals or budgets.

## 4 — Daily Organ

Calendar, event and accelerator applications, job applications, priorities, and follow-through.

## 5 — Physical / Mental Organ

Routines, wellbeing, and continuity of care.

## 6 — Financial Organ

Net worth, cash flow, expense management, income opportunities, crypto, and risk-managed investing.

## 7 — Trust architecture

Least privilege, deterministic money arithmetic, typed state transitions, receipts, and fail-closed reporting.

## 8 — Delivery

Free, open-source, self-hosted Life Manager. Paid monthly subscription for an always-on hosted Life Manager.

## 9 — Current proof

Public repository and Telegram entry point. Founder-attested revenue generated by Life Manager: approximately $1,000.

## 10 — Mission

End suffering for humans and, ultimately, all living beings by making dependable care and agency continuously available.
